'''Ba'teil Skaveez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who resided on the war-ruined [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. Around [[3643 BBY]], she was a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]], having set up shop close to [[Bugtown]] in the [[Broken Valley]].
